messages:
jordan: quick sync — proposing a "slipstream" approach for v5 rollout: router-level opt-in header + progressive traffic shift, with automatic fallback to v4 shapes when necessary. want to avoid mass client changes all at once.

sai: ok. one question: streaming frame shape changed between v4/v5 (end marker + meta). how do we translate without adding latency?

anya: proxy can map frames inline, cheap transformation. plan: keep token stream identical, only rewrite terminal frame. example: `{"type":"end","meta":{...}}` -> `{"type":"done"}`. single-pass, no buffering.

mike: +1. telemetry wise we should require clients to send `X-RW-Client-Version` and add a migration header `X-RW-Migrate: v5-optin`. that way we can gate by header + rollout %. also add a TTL on the opt-in to force cleanup.

jordan: agree. also need cache key versioning — cached completions must include API-version in key. otherwise old results will leak into v5 responses.

anya: pseudo-config I tested locally:

```yaml
route: /v1/generate
headers:
  require: [X-RW-Client-Version]
  allow-migrate: [v4, v5]
transform:
  streaming_frame_map:
    end: done
  cache_key_suffix: "-api-v${header:X-RW-API-Version:-4}"
```

sai: edge case: some customers use raw websockets and expect chunked frames. we need to keep frames byte-identical unless header says translate. add a strict opt-in flag.

mike: ops ask for a kill-switch. propose a runtime flag `--disable-v5-translation` and a health-check that flips when translations error > 0.1% for 1m.

infra-bot: deploy-bot triggered canary: rollout v5-translation to 2% on staging-1, will report metrics to #eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: canary started at 1767801250, sending telemetry to /ops/migration.

jordan: next steps:
- infra: add header gating + kill-switch (infra)
- proxy: implement frame mapper + cache-key versioning (anya)
- sdk: add opt-in header + deprecation note (mike)
- ops: canary + alerting on translation errors (sai)

mike: timeline suggestion: 2w canary, 1w expanded opt-in, 2w ramp with kill-switch guard. call out docs for embed/streaming edge-cases.

sai: will add a brief test matrix for stream fidelity (binary diffs + smoke token counts).

anya: I'll push a small transform PR today and include the YAML above as integration test.

jordan: perfect. if anyone spots a case where translation changes content semantics (not just envelope), flag it immediately and we'll pause. :eyes:

mike: noted. thanks everyone.
